name: VRM_ACCOUNTING_EVENTS
description: This table contains the accounting events of customer contract.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Revenue management accounting event unique identifier.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Source document line unique identifier.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Accounting event type. Values are from the lookup VRM_ACCOUNTING_EVENT_TYPE.

columns.name: REFERENCE_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Reference to the identifier of the event that triggered the accounting event.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_DATE
columns.description: Accounting date of the accounting event.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Accounting event amount in the performance obligation currency.

columns.name: ACCTD_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accounting event amount in the revenue contract currency.

columns.name: CONTRACT_ACTIVITY_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Customer contract activity group identifier.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Customer contract header unique identifier.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation unique identifier.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_LINE_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation line unique identifier.

columns.name: DEVOLVED_PERF_OBLIG_DTL_ID
columns.description: Devolved performance obligation details table unique record identifier. The value in this column refers to the devolved performance obligation record for which the initial performance event type accounting event is generated. This column is a foreign key reference to column DEVOLVED_PERF_OBLIG_DTL_ID in the VRM_DEVOLVED_PERF_OBLIG_DTLS table.

columns.name: REVERSED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this accounting event is reversed. Blank indicates reversed. N indicates not reversed.

columns.name: REVERSED_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or marked this row as reversed.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier of customer contract.

columns.name: PROCESS_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Accounting event processing status. Values are from the lookup ORA_ACCOUNTING_EVENT_STATUS.

columns.name: PROCESSED_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that processed this row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: POB_FIRST_BE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the current event being processed is the first billing event after sorting based on the accounting date under the performance obligation.

columns.name: POB_LAST_SE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the current event being processed is the last satisfaction event after sorting based on the accounting date under the performance obligation line.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_EVENT_SEQ_NUMBER
columns.description: Sequence number of the accounting event record.

columns.name: CREATED_FROM
columns.description: The process or user interface from which this row was created.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
